demos.name: BasicExampleDataGrid
demos.section: Overview
demos.description: See the dedicated section to learn how to create your own custom filter operator.

demos.name: InitialFilters
demos.section: Pass filters to the Data Grid › Initialize the filters
demos.description: To initialize the filters without controlling them, provide the model to the initialState prop.

demos.name: ControlledFilters
demos.section: Pass filters to the Data Grid › Controlled filters
demos.description: You can use the onFilterModelChange prop to listen to changes to the filters and update the prop accordingly.

demos.name: DisableFilteringGridAllColumns
demos.section: Disable the filters › For all columns
demos.description: Filters are enabled by default, but you can easily disable this feature by setting the disableColumnFilter prop.

demos.name: DisableFilteringGridSomeColumns
demos.section: Disable the filters › For some columns
demos.description: In the example below, the rating column cannot be filtered.

demos.name: ReadOnlyFilters
demos.section: Disable the filters › Filter non-filterable columns programmatically
demos.description: You can initialize the filterModel, set the filterModel prop, or use the API method apiRef.current.setFilterModel to set the filters for non-filterable columns.

demos.name: FilterApiNoSnap
demos.section: apiRef
demos.description: This API should only be used as a last resort when the Data Grid's built-in props aren't sufficient for your specific use case.

demos.name: CustomRatingOperator
demos.section: Filter customization › Customize the operators › Create a custom operator
demos.description: In the demo below, you can see how to create a completely new operator for the Rating column.

demos.name: CustomSelectionOperator
demos.section: Filter customization › Customize the operators › Wrap built-in operators
demos.description: In the demo below, the selected rows are always visible even when they don't match the filtering rules.

demos.name: CustomMultiValueOperator
demos.section: Filter customization › Customize the operators › Multiple values operator
demos.description: The filtering function getApplyFilterFn() must be adapted to handle filterItem.value as an array.

demos.name: RemoveBuiltInOperators
demos.section: Filter customization › Customize the operators › Remove an operator
demos.description: In the demo below, the rating column only has the operators.

demos.name: CustomInputComponent
demos.section: Filter customization › Customize the operators › Custom input component
demos.description: In the demo below, the rating column reuses the numeric operators but the rating component is used to enter the value of the filter.

demos.name: CustomFilterPanelContent
demos.section: Filter customization › Custom filter panel › Customize the filter panel content
demos.description: The value input is a special case, because it can contain a wide variety of components (the one provided or your custom InputComponent).

demos.name: CustomFilterPanelPosition
demos.section: Filter customization › Custom filter panel › Customize the filter panel position
demos.description: The demo below shows how to anchor the filter panel to the toolbar button instead of the column header.

demos.name: ApplyFiltersOnDemand
demos.section: Filter customization › Custom filter panel › Apply filters on demand
demos.description: By default, the filter panel writes directly to the grid's filter state, so each change is applied immediately.

demos.description: You can disable the default filter panel using the disableColumnFilter prop, and show only the default operator by passing slots.headerFilterMenu as null.

demos.name: HeaderFilteringInlineClearDataGridPro
demos.section: Header filters › Implementing header filters › Inline clear button
demos.description: By default, the Clear filter button is located in the header filter menu.

demos.name: CustomHeaderFilterSingleDataGridPro
demos.section: Header filters › Customizing header filters › One header filter cell in a specific column
demos.description: The demo below uses the renderHeaderFilter() method to hide the header filter cell for the Phone column and customize it for the Is admin?

demos.section: Header filters › Customizing header filters › All header filter cells in every column
demos.description: The default slot component handles keyboard navigation and focus management, so your custom component should also account for these accessibility features.

demos.section: Header filters › Customizing header filters › Header filter cells with custom filter operators
